name: Albedo
notes: A Geo sub-DPS whose Transient Blossoms scale with DEF (134% DEF at level 1). The Skill's own hit and the Burst scale with ATK, so the wiki's 'check' line for Skill DMG is settled as ATK; DEF is the scaling stat because the Blossoms carry most of the damage and both sources want DEF%. Both sources agree on 4pc Husk of Opulent Dreams or 4pc Golden Troupe and on DEF% Sands. Game8 also allows a DEF% Circlet, which the card leaves out as KQM does not. No DMG goal is set because the Goblet may be DEF% or Geo DMG%. Cinnabar Spindle is his signature and KQM's best 4-star, but Uraku Misugiri is both sources' top pick. Goals are Game8's (DEF 2000-3000, CR 60-70%, CD 140%+); ER is KQM's 2+ Geo units range (about 120-140%).
